senses.gloss: m. (רָבַץ) an animal that habitually breaks down under a load.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 33a:1">B. Mets. 33ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:5">Ex. XXIII, 5</cite>) <he>רוֹבֵץ ולא ר׳</he> ‘lying’, but not when it is in the habit of &c.

Ib. מה לי רובץ מה לי ר׳ (if it is a Biblical duty to relieve the suffering animal,) what difference does it make, whether the animal breaks down for the first time or did so before?; a. e.—Fem. רַבְצָנִית.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:6">Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 80a">B. Mets. 80ᵃ</cite>
